pitch:
**Demo-to-Deal Sprint** — in 3 weeks we turn your technical demo into a 7-minute enterprise pitch your team can run under pressure, built around cost savings, risk reduction and operational efficiency.

For seed / Series A founders in AI, logistics and supply chain who keep losing enterprise buyers in the demo.

We agree one metric up front — your advance-to-second-meeting rate on enterprise demos — and build the whole sprint to move it. You get:
1. A recorded friction teardown of your current demo (you keep it) — the exact points where enterprise buyers disconnect.
2. The rebuilt 7-minute value narrative, plus an Objection Playbook: the 10 hardest corporate-buyer objections in your category, with answers.
3. Live objection roleplay until your team can run the pitch without the script — not a document, an installed capability.

**Advance-rate guarantee:** if your advance-to-second-meeting rate doesn't improve versus your baseline, we re-run the sprint free. The metric is one we control — not the close, which depends on your product and buyer.

Delivered by one operator with a deep industrial / operations background and enterprise commercial experience — an insider on what actually moves an operations buyer. Fully remote. No equity, no monthly retainer, no software for you to build.

**Founding cohort: 5 slots** at €4,900 (vs €9,500 standard), in exchange for a documented before/after result and a testimonial. Prefer a smaller first step? Start with the 1-week **Demo Audit** at €2,900, credited toward the full sprint.
